vo_anchor.citation: Merriles et al. (2020), J. Chem. Phys. 153, 024303
vo_anchor.access: Web-rendered author accepted manuscript inspected, especially sections III.B, IV.A and Figure 1 caption. Publisher version of record/PDF not downloaded; no file checksum.
vo_anchor.atomic_limit: V(4F_3/2) + O(3P_2), the lowest fine-structure separated-atom levels (Figure 1).
vo_anchor.uncertainty_definition: Conservative assigned error limit covering molecular-beam rotational temperature, laser linewidth/calibration and all four excitation thresholds; not explicitly a one-standard-deviation estimate.
vo_anchor.initial_state_check: The approximately 9 cm^-1 lower fourth threshold is attributed to initial excitation of the upper VO ground-term spin component; calculated separation 8.998 cm^-1.
vo_anchor.method_limitation: A dissociation barrier would make the predissociation threshold an upper limit. Authors consider this unlikely from the dense state manifold and agreement across excitation paths.

independent_reanchor.scope: Diagnostic retaining the original selected reaction enthalpy, before thermal-function re-reduction; EuO-independent and not an adopted value or newly assigned uncertainty.
independent_reanchor.common_reference: Use 0 K molecular ground levels and lowest fine-structure atomic levels throughout. A common elemental energy-gauge change cancels from the balanced reaction; a physical D0 revision does not. Do not mix 298 K formation enthalpies, De/ZPE conventions or term-centroid energies without explicit conversion.
independent_reanchor.historical_gap_diagnostic: JANAF 1236.342 minus original Balducci 1177 is +59.342 kJ/mol in molecular energy. That source-gap perturbation is distinct from the modern-VO reanchor; the latter nominally implies +47.34900250587202 kJ/mol relative to that JANAF D0.
